title: M5 target-project trust-change authorization decision
goal: Accept a consumer-neutral base-held two-step authorization capability and close the V4-TODO-015 evaluation without implementing or activating it.
acceptanceCriteria: V4-AD-044 defines a trusted-base protected set and a base-held single-use authorization record consumed by a separate trust-change Plan.
Candidate-only, missing, partial, reused, mismatched and self-authorizing records remain required negative cases for implementation.
V4-TODO-015 closes only as an evaluation and V4-TODO-023 tracks public contracts, behavior and certification.
Target application, pull-request delivery and workflow or ruleset activation remain separate operations.
No product code, contract, authorization record, protected path, workflow, ruleset, consumer repository or remote state changes occur.
risks: A target could otherwise authorize a changed evaluator with candidate-controlled policy.
A decision-complete backlog item could be mistaken for an implemented public capability.
Authorization could be collapsed with Target application or remote activation.
decisions: D27 accepts a consumer-neutral public target-project trust-change authorization capability based on Guard's base-held single-use two-step model.
